name: Ithamar
overview: Ithamar, son of Aaron, played a vital role in the service of the tabernacle as one of the priests entrusted with its sacred duties and the management of its resources. Scripture highlights his responsibility over the Levites' service and the handling of the tabernacle's finances, emphasizing his trusted position (Exodus 38:21; Numbers 4:28). Following the tragic death of his brothers Nadab and Abihu, Ithamar, along with Eleazar, was commanded by Moses not to mourn openly or leave the tabernacle, underscoring the holiness and consecration required in their priestly office (Leviticus 10:6-7). His lineage and priestly service affirm the continuity of Aaron’s family in fulfilling God's ordained worship.
